scope: One mapped straight seating front, not surveyed seats or a complete public-ticket inventory. No footprint, height, eye offset or obstacle is moved.

source.notes: The mapped southern straight boundary is the track-facing edge. Row direction follows this original edge instead of the PCA of the complete rear-notched footprint.
